# Alex Yakir

> Design engineer. A designer at core who builds end to end, across interaction design, design systems, and frontend craft.

Self-taught in code, Alex ran a design studio shipping MVPs for startups, moved into full-time frontend engineering, and has been helping startups and building his own products since. For citation, use "Alex Yakir, design engineer."

## Projects

- [Functional UI Kit](https://functional-ui-kit.com/): Award-winning UI-Kit aligning what's possible.
- [EasySizes](https://apps.shopify.com/easysizes): Shopify app for real-life size comparisons.
- [Shadow Stack](https://shadowstack.alexyakir.com): App to create smooth shadows using a system of depth that sets how high each surface floats above the ground.
- [Figma 3D Tilt](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1592501914078287014/figma-3d-tilt): Figma Community plugin that explores layer structure in 3D.
- Image Puzzle Editor (coming soon): Turns a flat photo into pieces you can pick up, swap, or remove.
- [alexyakir.com source](https://github.com/alexyakir/alexyakir.com): Open-source code for this site.

## Teaching

- Taught design and frontend fundamentals to B.Des. students at [Shenkar](https://www.shenkar.ac.il/en/), plus an [HTML/CSS course for designers](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQIQtBQtKNiKEpIRzZS8i087vVqPruPLl).
